北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾气浓，出行注意交通和呼吸健康哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy. Drive safely and mind your respiratory health!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光好，气温 21℃，多喝水，记得防晒！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny. Stay hydrated and protect yourself from the sun!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴空万里，气温舒适，适合出门走走呀！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is clear and comfortable. Perfect for a leisurely stroll!
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨，体感 26℃，带伞防潮，小心湿滑！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain, feels like 26℃. Bring an umbrella, watch for dampness and slippery spots!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天 25℃，心情要保持晴朗，出门愉快哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, 25℃. Keep your spirits sunny and enjoy your day out!
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云 22℃，天气宜人，尽情享受悠闲时光！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, 22℃. The weather is pleasant, enjoy your relaxing time!
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗风稍大，出门别被风吹感冒啦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is clear with some wind. Don't let the breeze give you a cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都小雨湿度 100%，带伞防滑，小心出行呀！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu has light rain and 100% humidity. Bring an umbrella, be careful of slippery roads!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云微热，注意补充水分，保持舒爽哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels warm. Remember to hydrate and stay comfortable!
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天 18℃，凉意渐浓，记得添衣保暖哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, 18℃. It's getting cooler, remember to add layers and stay warm!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天湿度高，心情要保持阳光，别忘了微笑！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy with high humidity. Keep your spirits bright, and don't forget to smile!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨气温 12℃，体感很凉。多穿衣服，注意保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is 12℃ and feels quite cool. Dress warmly and stay bundled up!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳风力 5级体感凉。出门防风保暖，注意安全！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has 5-level wind and feels cool. Dress warm, protect from wind, and stay safe!
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降8℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云风力 4级。体感偏凉，记得多带件外套！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy with 4-level wind. It feels cooler, remember to bring a jacket!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门风力 6级体感凉！请注意防风保暖，小心出行！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has strong 6-level wind and feels cool! Protect from wind, stay warm, and be careful!
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 6级

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云 13℃，风力稍大，记得多添衣物保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and 13℃ with some wind. Remember to layer up and stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 10℃，风力 4级。多穿点，别着凉，暖暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like 10℃ with 4-level wind. Dress warmly, avoid colds, and stay cozy!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃
